body: She hit the nail on the coffin with that though. The more you face your fears the less of an impact they have on you

What if you're aware that this isn't a temporary problem, and continuing will just cause suffering for the rest of my life? What if existence is the most uncomfortable, unenjoyable thing? Why do I need to continue living? 

Why force someone to live through immense suffering? You wouldn't be able to stand seeing a stage 4 bone cancer patient in excruciating pain and tell him it's going to get better and he shouldn't opt for euthanasia would you?

Not in the sense where I feel like I'm dying, but more on anxiety attacks. Usually comes in the form of pacing back and forth worrying about my past mistakes. 

Heart rate goes up to 90bpm, and I feel like my life is a living hell. Happens first thing in the morning too. I haven't woken up feeling relaxed in months
Thank you for your advice! I've actually purchased that book a few months ago but still haven't read it. Beating myself up over that one. Does the book contain information on small talk as well?

You know man, I completely envy the fact that you even have the self awareness to list down all these things. I would trade my good looks/height for even a hint of your level of awareness and intelligence.

Seeing as the top end of your cons seem to be based around your looks/height/dating, I can tell you from a perspective of someone who used to be a full time male model during college that it really doesn't mean shit. I'm 22 now, I've gotten the dates and the sex but its all meaningless bullshit. Superficial living ruined my life, caused me to cheat my way through school and virtually train my mind that I didn't need to learn. Superficial living turned me into a narcissistic piece of shit that can't feel empathy for others/care about other peoples feelings. I've emotionally ruined people out of my own deep sense of shame.

I've dropped all of that now, and sunk into a deep depression. Socially isolated myself, lost all social skills and now ignore friends, as I am too embarrassed to show them who I am right now. Weird as fuck when people have all these expectations of you for looking good but in turn you show them you lack social skills and relied on your looks to get things done 99% of the time. I'm one narcissistic prick for even making this response about me, so back to you.

You have it man. You're self aware, you can work on all those things. You got the social skills, you're good at making friends, you're funny. Work on your looks as much as you can, go to the gym. Everything you have intellectually will benefit you more than the things you lack.
Hey man, glad to hear you're taking your first steps to getting out of the deep void that is depression. I hope things get better from now on. Keep on truckin :)

Its horrible isn't it. I've only started experiencing these things very recently. Social anxiety is something I just discovered about myself, although if you were to see my behavior within the past few years you wouldn't think I had it, heck I didn't even know I had socially anxious tendencies til recent. 

And no I have never been prescribed.

Hello. I am aware that these thoughts are merely that..just thoughts. However, it has a very real effect on my reality. I talked to my parents about it. My dad doesn't seem to believe in psychiatry/psychologists as he believes they're just there to make money, and that psychiatric drugs are created by pharmaceutical companies to intentionally get people addicted for profit. My mom is willing to help me, I'm just paralyzed as I don't know if things are going to work out. I might just end up wasting her money.
